description: `imagemagick`'s own candidate list (`magick, convert`) resolves through the case's own `fakes/` directory first on PATH (issue #450 item 4) -- named literally `magick`, so no real ImageMagick needs to be installed. The fake's own resolved path lands in the tool result's `raw.binary`, the first real exercise of the `GenericSubprocessTool` candidate-fallback order this lane's own `imagemagick` plugin uses (the order itself -- `magick` absent, falling back to `convert` -- is tested in Rust with a controlled `PATH`, not here).
